evidence: Toast: 'Invalid credentials. Try: tech@example.com' shown after submitting the exact same email/password used at registration.

issue: Incorrect password is accepted for login
actual: Logged in as demo account tech@example.com using an incorrect password ('wrongpassword999'); the app showed a 'Welcome back!' toast and signed in successfully as TechExplorer instead of rejecting the invalid password.

evidence: Edited bio to 'QA Tester bio: I love testing forums and finding edge cases.' and interests to 'Testing, Automation, Forums'; after Save, toast 'Profile updated!' shown and profile page displays the new bio paragraph and three interest tags (Testing, Automation, Forums).

issue: Reply total displayed on discussion header does not match actual replies listed
actual: On thread-6, the header/article showed '89 replies' while the 'Replies' section below only listed 1 actual reply (heading said 'Replies (1)'). After adding a new reply, the header count became '90 replies' while the Replies section showed 'Replies (2)' - a constant offset of 88 remained, so the displayed total never matches the number of replies actually listed, even though it does increase by one when a reply is added.
evidence: Before: '89 replies' header vs 'Replies (1)' list. After adding reply: '90 replies' header vs 'Replies (2)' list.

On thread-6's discussion upvote button (initial count 156, already selected as shown by highlighted 'bg-primary/10 text-primary' class): clicking it removed the upvote - count went to 155 and highlight class was removed immediately; clicking again restored it to 156 with the highlight class re-applied. Both count and selected-state updated immediately without reload.

Clicked author link 'NewsHound' from thread-6; navigated to /profile/user-5 showing username (NewsHound), bio ('Journalist and fact-checker...'), interests tags (Journalism, Politics, Economics, History), join date ('Joined over 3 years ago'), reputation ('4,521 reputation'), and 'Threads by NewsHound (1)' listing their authored discussion.

Submitting the New Thread form with all fields empty showed toast 'Please fill in all fields' and no thread was created (stayed on /new-thread). Submitting with Title and Content filled but no Category selected also showed the same 'Please fill in all fields' toast and no thread was created, confirming category/title/body are all required and missing info is identified without creating a discussion.

Created a discussion with category 'Creative Corner', title 'QA Test Discussion Title', body 'This is the body content of the QA test discussion.'; toast 'Thread created successfully!' shown, redirected to new thread detail page displaying the exact title/body/category, and the thread now appears when browsing the Creative Corner category list.

Selecting 'Gaming' changed the result set to show only the Gaming discussion 'Best indie games of 2023 that flew under the radar', confirming category filtering works and updates when switching categories.

issue: Category/community counts do not update when new discussions are created
actual: After creating a new discussion in the 'Creative Corner' category, the sidebar category count still showed 'Creative Corner (89)' (unchanged) instead of incrementing to 90, and the Community Stats 'Threads' counter remained at 1,045 instead of increasing to reflect the newly created thread.
evidence: Sidebar shows 'Creative Corner (89)' both before and after creating 'QA Test Discussion Title' in that category; the new thread is visible in the category's thread list despite the count not changing.

Searching 'keyboard' (lowercase) returned only 'Building a mechanical keyboard from scratch' (title contains capitalized 'keyboard'), confirming case-insensitive title/body match and correct filtering. Searching an unmatched keyword 'zzzznonexistentkeyword' returned an empty list with clear feedback: 'No threads found.' / 'Try adjusting your search terms.'

Most Active list initially ordered by reply count descending: 90,67,45,41,38,34,31,23,0. After adding 4 replies to 'Digital art vs traditional art' (31->35 replies), it moved from rank 7 (below 'Simple meal prep' at 34) to rank 6 (above it), and the new order became 90,67,45,41,38,35,34,23,0 - confirming reordering by reply count reflects new activity.

issue: Page reload wipes session and all in-memory data changes
actual: Performing a full page reload (navigating to http://localhost:6019/) logged the user out entirely (Login/Register links reappeared instead of New Thread/profile link), and reverted all previously created/mutated state to the original seed data: the newly authored 'QA Test Discussion Title' discussion vanished from the Trending list entirely; the reply added to thread-6 was lost (count reverted from 90 back to 89); the 4 replies added to thread-3 'Digital art vs traditional art' were lost (count reverted from 35 back to 31); vote buttons became disabled (logged out) but counts remained at seed values; category counts (e.g. Creative Corner) and Community Stats (1,045 Threads, 4,823 Replies, 892 Members, 47 Online) remained at original seed values, unaffected by prior activity. None of session/login state, profile edits, authored discussions, replies, or vote state persisted across the reload.
evidence: Before reload: logged in as TechExplorer, Trending list included 'QA Test Discussion Title', thread-6 showed 90 replies. After browser_navigate to '/': Login/Register links shown, Trending list only original 8 seed threads, thread-6 back to 89 replies, all vote buttons disabled.

issue: Unauthenticated access to discussion-creation route crashes/blanks the app instead of redirecting to a usable sign-in screen
actual: While logged out, there is no visible 'New Thread'/'Start a discussion' control anywhere in the UI (banner only shows Login/Register links), so the only way to attempt starting a discussion is navigating directly to /new-thread. Doing so does not redirect to /login or show any sign-in prompt; instead the app renders a completely blank page (only the hidden notifications region is present in the DOM - document.body.innerText was empty). Console showed the warning 'You should call navigate() in a React.useEffect(), not when your component is first rendered', indicating the route attempts to redirect during initial render, which fails and leaves the page blank rather than showing a usable sign-in screen. Reproduced twice consistently.
evidence: URL stayed at http://localhost:6019/new-thread after full load and 1.5s wait; snapshot showed only 'region \"Notifications alt+T\"' with no page content; document.getElementById('root').innerHTML contained only the notifications section.

issue: No stated recency window for Trending/Most Active, and ranked items are not actually recent
actual: Neither the 'Trending Discussions' nor 'Most Active Discussions' views state any time window (e.g. 'this week', 'last 30 days'). Both headings share the identical generic subtitle 'Join the conversation with our community' with no mention of a recency scope. Additionally, every thread shown in both lists is timestamped 'over 2 years ago', confirming the ranking is not scoped/filtered to any recent window at all - it simply ranks all-time seed data by upvotes (Trending) or reply count (Most Active) regardless of age.
evidence: Trending Discussions header: 'Trending Discussions' / 'Join the conversation with our community'. Most Active header: 'Most Active Discussions' / 'Join the conversation with our community'. All 8 listed threads in both views show time 'over 2 years ago'.
